tummy ache noun

also stomach ache, colic, stomach trouble, stomach problems

classical

Traupman 385
Traupman 55–56: stomachus dolet
Traupman 66: stomachō labōrāre, to have stomach trouble

dolor stomachī

Other words

  • tormina — colic

    also used · classical · M-O s.v. abdominal pain; Cic.; Plin.

Examples

    My tummy hurts.composed

  • stomachō (corde, tergō) dolēre

    to have stomach (heart, back) problemsTraupman 365
